A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Gaussian Mapping for Evolving Scenes. All pages, equations, five figures, nine tables, and references are readable and can be matched. Neither supplied PDF contains a separate appendix.

before.justification: v2 reports original mapping and rendering experiments on Flat, Aria, and TUM-RGBD, including baseline comparisons, component ablations, robustness tests, and runtime measurements.

after.justification: v3 retains the work's original experimental results on Flat, Aria, and TUM-RGBD, including the comparisons and analyses in Tables 1–9.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 substantially revise the stated update procedure. v3 removes the described reset of existing Gaussians, revises seeding to use scaled signed depth overshoot and color error, and specifies optimization against the current keyframe. Add masking changes from SAM-based regions to morphological closing, while keyframe exclusion changes from fully covered masks to any sufficiently covered mask. The objective drops explicit color/depth weights and newly describes isotropic regularization. These affect core operations despite retaining the overall DSA/keyframe architecture.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same Flat sequences, Aria room0/room1, and TUM-RGBD desk, xyz, and office scenes. Scene-change, estimated-pose, and static-scene coverage is retained.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain SplaTAM, MonoGS, and DG-SLAM on Flat/Aria and for runtime, and SplaTAM/MonoGS on TUM-RGBD. Wild-GS remains explicitly unevaluated; no comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Section 5 retains concatenated recordings, every-tenth-frame novel-view holdout, ground-truth poses for controlled comparisons, full-resolution rendering, and the same PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and depth metrics. No evaluation protocol or experimental budget revision is reported.

E4.justification: The same analyses test Add/Remove components, keyframe filtering, estimated poses, final refinement, and hyperparameter sensitivity in Tables 3–5 and 8–9. Their experimental variants and qualitative examples are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same means and standard deviations across hyperparameter perturbations of ±10% and ±20% in Table 9. Neither adds repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Every numerical entry in Tables 1–9 is identical, including GaME's Flat PSNR of 24.55/24.26 dB and depth error of 6.9/7.9 cm for input/novel views. The qualitative images and reported empirical findings are also retained.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions receive local revisions: Eq. 8 adds scaled signed depth overshoot and a color threshold, Eq. 9 uses a per-pixel color residual, and Eq. 10 changes the opacity inequality from less-than to greater-than-or-equal. Eq. 4 also removes the outer loss weights. No theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty claims for online NVS mapping of evolving scenes, DSA, and keyframe management. The headline 29.7% PSNR and approximately threefold depth-error improvement claims remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 4.1 newly explains that isotropic regularization prevents degenerate Gaussian shapes. Experimental interpretations and the limitations concerning short-term dynamics, external pose tracking, and missing full scene history otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 newly specifies that SAM masks are precomputed and explains the existing L1/SSIM mixing weight. It also removes v2's 'Released upon acceptance' code-release qualifier, while retaining the project address. Actual resource availability cannot be verified from the PDFs.

R1.justification: Both versions cite the same 44 works and retain the related-work discussion and novelty positioning. The regularization sentence reuses the existing Gaussian-SLAM reference without substantively changing research positioning.

P1.justification: Several method paragraphs are rewritten, alongside a small abstract edit, a caption typo correction, and updated author affiliations. The section sequence and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 compacts the author block, places the introduction beside the abstract, tightens spacing, and relocates existing figures and tables within the text. All five figures retain identical imagery, and the nine tables retain their designs and contents.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves technical clarity and internal consistency: Eq. 10 now aligns its opacity condition with selecting visible Gaussians, per-pixel change tests are explicit, and Add/Remove masking is distinguished. These gains support a limited improvement in the paper's description. New seeding thresholds and the mask-coverage cutoff remain unspecified, and the unchanged experiments do not establish a performance benefit from the revised procedure.
